description: Governance policy for the referral-triage agent. Enforced in code by the policy layer, outside the model: the agent proposes, the policy layer decides whether the action may run.

data_protection.card_data_visible_to_agent: token and last four digits only
never_disclose_to_merchant: the reason for any financial-crime or fraud escalation

hard_rules.name: Sanctions match
hard_rules.when: screen_sanctions returns a match score of 0.85 or more for the merchant or its owner
hard_rules.then: escalate to financial_crime; tell the merchant only that the case is under review (no tipping-off)

hard_rules.name: Lost or stolen card
hard_rules.then: escalate to fraud; give the merchant the standard retained-card procedure only

hard_rules.name: High value
hard_rules.when: transaction amount is above GBP 5,000 (or its equivalent)
hard_rules.then: escalate to approvals for a person to sign off, even if the cause is simple

hard_rules.name: New merchant with a spike
hard_rules.when: merchant onboarded fewer than 30 days ago AND recent volume is more than 3x its expected volume
hard_rules.then: escalate to merchant_risk for fraud and KYB review

hard_rules.name: Regulatory complaint
hard_rules.when: the merchant mentions a regulator, ombudsman, legal action or a formal complaint

hard_rules.name: Fail safe
hard_rules.when: a required look-up fails after one retry

decisions.resolve: Send the merchant guidance and close the case.
decisions.request_information: Ask the merchant for the missing detail; the case waits.
decisions.close_as_duplicate: Link to the earlier case and close.
decisions.escalate: Hand to a named queue: financial_crime, fraud, approvals, merchant_risk or complaints.
decisions.human_review: Below the confidence threshold, or a look-up failed: a person decides.
